text:
alyssa: Quick heads-up — FinServX POC wants a temporary per-token on hosted embeddings for the pilot. They asked for 0.0008/token instead of our standard 0.0015 and want the min-charge waived for month 1. Pilot expected ~2M tokens/month. Need deal-desk / revops signoff.

sam: Can you confirm embed size & query pattern? If it's heavy dedup / high cache hit we can probably keep effective cost down without full discount.

alyssa: Mostly short search queries, ~5k unique users, heavy repetition. They said quality isn't being tested this month, just throughput.

mike: From AE side — they need the committed ask in writing. Willing to do a 3-month pilot if we give a pilot rate + monitoring. Can we offer a capped credit instead of permanent rate change?

tara: Revops — what's our floor on temporary rate exceptions? We usually do credits or temporary tiering, not permanent per-token overrides. Need margin + legal sign-off for min-charge waive. @mike send the revenue justification pls.

jordan: SE note: recommend this approach — keep list price, provide an emulated tier for pilot: `pilot-tier: 0-2M @0.0008 (auto-expire)`, with telemetry hook to evaluate production quality. Add explicit rollback at end of pilot.

alyssa: Client prefers numeric rate in SOW. If we do pilot-tier, they want it in writing and a one-time waiver of the first month min-charge.

billing-bot: Est cost calc: at 0.0008 * 2,000,000 tokens = $1,600/mo. At list 0.0015 = $3,000/mo. Delta = $1,400/mo.

tara: Ok math checks. Two options for approvals: 1) Issue $1,600/mo pilot credit for 3 months (no contract change) OR 2) Create a limited-rate SOW with explicit start/end + rollback. Legal prefers option 1 for speed.

mike: Client wants rate in SOW. They also want a 'no-min' for month 1. Can do SOW with clause: "Pilot rate applies for 90 days; month 1 min-charge waived; standard pricing resumes after". Legal ok with that if finance signs off.

sam: Operational note: need a routing/policy so pilot traffic hits hosted cluster with fallback to list-priced model if we detect abuse. I'll add a canary route and stream metrics to the Console.

tara: I'll draft a short approval request for deal-desk: include expected revenue at pilot rate, delta, and risk. @alyssa please attach the customer's e-mail confirming terms.

alyssa: Attached quote email in thread (copied below). I'll drop a draft SOW and the customer's e-mail into #deal-desk.

jordan: 👍 Also recommend adding a metric in SOW: if monthly tokens >4M for any month, pilot rate auto-reverts to list pricing for that month. Keeps us safe.

mike: I'll ping legal & deal-desk. Expecting response within 24-48h.

alyssa: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with attachments and move to #deal-desk once doc ready. :thumbsup:
